Project Overview: Offline Multilingual Self-Verifying RAG Antigravity Labs was founded in 2021 to pioneer edge-native document AI.

The project handles long, heterogeneous technical documents.

 Experimental Evaluation Results:

In Experiment 4B, the hybrid retrieval mechanism improved recall by 28.5% over basic dense retrieval.

The evaluation was conducted on 500 multi-hop benchmark queries across English and Hindi.

 Deployment Specifications:

The offline edge model uses 3.2 billion parameters and runs locally via Ollama without any cloud APIs.
